title: Loved the tour
text: We had a great time on this tour on our first night in Seville. We went to places we would not have found, and were challenged to try some different foods and drinks. Ferran was a great guide, and gave up tips for the rest of our time in Seville. We all were even treated to an unexpected procession from a nearby church that evening!
